verdict.rationale: GitLab runs a technology-partners integration directory listing many third-party integrations (Make, monday.com, Notion, Semgrep, PagerDuty and others). It also has an AI Catalog where developers can discover agents and flows made by the GitLab team and community members. The evidence does not show an in-product install flow from the partner directory; listings mostly describe partner-side setup. missing for 10: documented install/enable workflow from the directory, in-product marketplace UI, independent hands-on corroboration of installing catalog items.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install third-party integrations from a marketplace or app directory

citations.quote: Discover agents and flows created by the GitLab team and community members. Create custom agents and flows, and share them with other users.
Our monday.com - GitLab integration offers you a simple set up to start connecting your business and development teams.
Make allows you to connect GitLab to more than 700 ready-made applications or to any API to integrate your DevSecOps processes
